daily.today_energy: Your Mars energy is hitting different today. Channel that raw momentum into something meaningful—whether that's starting that project you've been doom-scrolling about or just owning a room with your presence. The vibes are aligned for action.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your person might need some reassurance today. If you're single, don't force connections—the universe is basically telling you to vibe with yourself first. Self-love is the real romance energy right now.
daily.career: Your ideas are actually fire today, but timing matters. Speak up in meetings or share that vision you've been sitting on. The universe is opening doors for those bold enough to walk through them. Trust your gut on decisions.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement—whether that's a walk, dancing, or a workout that actually feels good, not punishing. Listen to what makes you feel alive. Rest when you need it; pushing through burnout isn't the move.

weekly.overview: Mercury's moving through your sector of communication this week, Aries. It's giving permission to finally say the things you've been sitting on. Trust your instincts—they're sharper than usual. Channel that fire energy into something that actually matters to you.
weekly.love: There's a softness available to you right now that doesn't require you to dim your brightness. Whether you're coupled or solo, vulnerability is the move. The universe is rewirng your heart chakra to understand that strength and tenderness coexist. Let people see you.
weekly.career: This is your moment to pitch, propose, or pivot if something's been feeling off. Your confidence is cosmic-coded right now, and people feel it. Don't shrink yourself down for comfort—your boldness is exactly what's needed. Trust the momentum building around you.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishment. Dance, walk, stretch—whatever makes you feel alive in your skin. Energy levels are high but scattered; grounding practices like breathwork will help you feel more centered and intentional throughout the week.
